parsed.note_claim: The viral video of police recording dancers at the Lat Bhairav procession is not AI-generated; Alt News found it real, with multiple videos from different angles of the event matching.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Several social media users posted videos of the same programme captured from different angles. Uniformed police personnel were standing on the stage as well as below the stage watching the dancers as the performance went on.
parsed.reason: The Alt News article directly substantiates that the video is real and that multiple videos of the event from different angles match, concluding the DCP's AI-generated claim does not hold up.
